// diagnostic E0355

Jet.InvalidScopedPolicy

A scoped policy is unknown, conflicts, widens an inherited constraint, or is attached at a prohibited scope.

What

A scoped policy is unknown, conflicts, widens an inherited constraint, or is attached at a prohibited scope.

Why

One compiler-owned matrix resolves package → module → function → block while keeping the full declaration chain. Audited authority stays at its sound site.

Fix

Use `#Policy(gc)`, `#Policy(explicit_units)`, `#Policy(copies: .Explicit)`, or `#Policy(sentries: .Off)`; write memory floors as `!Mem.*` effect denials.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.InvalidScopedPolicy: Tests/UI/callable_policy_invalid.stderr.

Error: Jet.InvalidScopedPolicy: Unknown callable policy setting `nope`
  --> Tests/UI/callable_policy_invalid.jet:3:29
    |
  3 | run: fn() { selected: apply(nope(1), load) }
    |                             ^^^^
 Why: A callable policy name must be a compiler-owned setting or a public policy declared in this package
 Fix: Declare `policy nope(...) { wrap(call) { … } }`
